name: Accidentally Summoned the Demon King
source:
Kyle hates Kim for being the popular boy in the classroom. Out of nowhere a demon king appears to help Kyle redeem himself.

Will he succeed?

[From [url=https://purple-bear.itch.io/accidentally-summoned-the-demon-lord-nsfw]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凯尔讨厌金，因为金是班里最受欢迎的男孩。忽然，一位魔王现身，要帮助凯尔挽回颜面。

他能成功吗？

[摘自[url=https://purple-bear.itch.io/accidentally-summoned-the-demon-lord-nsfw]Itch.io[/url]]
